speaker.name: Celtia Castelo Gajino
speaker.title: Pathplanning & Control Lead
speaker.bio:
Hi! I'm Celtia, a final-year Mathematics and Computer Engineering student at the University of Santiago de Compostela.

I'm currently involved in Auria, a Formula Student team, where I lead the Path Planning area of the Driverless division. Our goal is to develop algorithms that enable an autonomous racing car to determine its optimal trajectory and speed.

I also have experience in data engineering, machine learning research, and cloud-based software development. I particularly enjoy working on projects that bring together mathematical modelling, programming, and practical applications.
